title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official 2026 Asian Games men's football results, corroborated by reliable match reporting. 
  Resolution : Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded. If China wins gold, resolve to no country. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The opposing country's name, or “None” if China wins gold.
